title: Smoke Testing — Overview
summary: A quick shallow pass over critical functionality to decide if a build is worth deeper testing.
body:
A quick shallow pass over critical functionality to decide if a build is worth deeper testing. Standard build-verification practice.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Build Verification, Sanity Testing, CI Gates.
